missing_evidence: Payment service-side latency/error metrics and logs to confirm payment is the slow dependency rather than a caller-side timeout config
candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from payment authorization calls timing out (~2.0s ReadTimeout, error.type=transport) on POST payment; order and checkout propagate the failure as 502 while inventory/redis succeed.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment ReadTimeout but no payment-side telemetry; exact root within payment is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), causing order and checkout 502s; inventory/redis succeed. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Deployment record only shows gateway v1.0.0 baseline and does not establish causation.
